zh: 同时调整该档的身体与镜头抖动；伤害越高，抖动越强。
en: Adjusts body and screen shake together for this tier. Larger hits still shake more.

zh: 拉近数值越大越近；时停速度越小越慢，1 为正常速度。
en: Higher zoom moves closer. Lower hitstop speed slows more; 1 is normal speed.

zh: 完整地图 · 竖屏排版
交战跟拍 · 自动推拉
上限包含等于：第一门槛以内微弱，第二门槛以内轻微，超过第二门槛明显。自动校验两道门槛的顺序。
en: Limits are inclusive: faint up to the first, light up to the second, strong above the second. Limits stay ordered.

zh: 只改身体显示，不改碰撞或位移。身体倍率设为 0 可关闭身体抖动；镜头开关不控制身体。
en: Visual body offset only; never changes collisions or movement. Zero body gain disables body shake independently of the camera switch.

zh: 幅度为视口逻辑像素。屏幕倍率也作用于技能的镜头抖动；设为 0 可关闭屏幕抖动。
en: Amplitude is in logical viewport pixels. Screen gain also scales skill camera shake; zero disables screen shake.

zh: 增长尺度越大，高伤害增长越慢；曲线指数越小，增长越快。时间单位秒，频率单位 Hz。
en: Larger growth scales slow the increase for strong hits; smaller exponents increase faster. Time is in seconds; frequency in Hz.

zh: 实际触发门槛＝最低伤害与生命百分比的较大值，再限制到门槛封顶。百分比设为 0 可只用伤害门槛。时间为真实秒。
en: Trigger = max(minimum damage, reference health times percentage), limited by the threshold cap. Zero percent uses damage only. Timing uses real seconds.

zh: 门槛取最低伤害与生命百分比的较大值。速度倍率越小，时停越强；1 为正常速度。时间为真实秒；联机与训练中不启用时停。
en: Trigger = max(minimum damage, reference health times percentage). Lower time scales pause harder; 1 is normal speed. Real seconds; hitstop remains disabled online and in training.

zh: 录制中不能更改画面取景。
en: Camera framing is locked while recording.

zh: 左键：完全重演上一把（相同初始方向与随机结果）；右键：相同地图/人物/位置，重新随机
en: Left click: replay the previous match with the same initial directions and random results; right click: reuse the same map, characters, and positions with fresh randomness.

zh: 左键：录制当前对决画面，按钮变红表示正在录制，再点一次停止并输出 mp4；右键：以低倍速模拟重打上一把并直接输出 mp4，对局不在游戏画面中呈现
en: Left click: record the current match; the button turns red while recording, click again to stop and write the mp4. Right click: replay the previous match at low speed as a simulation and write the mp4 directly, without showing the match in the game view.
Who do you think will win?
Which side are you rooting for?
Who will survive to the end?
Which side will be wiped out first?
Do you think there will be a comeback?
Pick a side before you see the result!
Is this really an even match?

keys: 人数更多的一边一定会赢吗？
zh: 人数更多的一边一定会赢吗？
en: Does the side with more units always win?
Guess before you see the result!

keys: 你觉得谁会成为最后赢家？
zh: 你觉得谁会成为最后赢家？
en: Who will be the final winner?
Do you even know how to play?

zh: 仅勾选的事件有机会随机触发。
en: Only checked events can be randomly selected.

zh: 暂无可选事件，后续添加。
随机生成不会融化的雪片；地面造成寒冷伤害，墙面仅作装饰。
en: Permanent random snow patches. Ground snow causes cold damage; wall snow is decorative only.

zh: 按住右键连续发射；有角色时自动瞄准最近角色，无角色时按鼠标移动方向自由瞄准
en: Hold right click to fire; aims at the nearest character, or follows mouse movement when no target exists

zh: 请先在当前地图放置训练角色
en: Place a training character on the current map

zh: 分类全部关闭：请至少开启一个分类，才能放置随机虚影。
en: All categories are off. Enable a category to place random slots.

zh: 可抽取 %d 位人物；放置虚影后，按 M 收起工具栏开始抽取。
en: %d characters available. Place silhouettes, then press M to reveal.

zh: 当前没有可抽取人物：请开启分类或取消部分人物的排除。
en: No eligible characters. Enable categories or unexclude some characters.

zh: 在“队伍”页点击人物：红色 X＝排除，再点恢复。切换模式会保留设置。
en: In Teams, red X means excluded. Click again to restore. Settings survive mode changes.

zh: 已排除：不会随机抽到；再次点击恢复。
en: Excluded from random draws. Click again to restore.

zh: 点击排除；再次点击恢复参与抽奖。
en: Click to exclude; click again to restore eligibility.

zh: 障碍物不参与随机抽取。
en: Obstacles do not participate in random draws.

zh: 正在抽取 · 等待命运揭晓
全部揭晓后，战斗才会开始
全员就绪 · 即将开战
对战盔甲架时显示人物介绍
en: Show character intro vs armor stand

zh: ……滚一边去，别故意在我眼前晃悠。
en: …Get out of my way. Stop deliberately loitering in front of me.

zh: 快捷键：空格重播  ←/→切换  [/]调大小  C人物  A循环  M音效  1/2/3/4直选
en: Shortcuts: Space replay  ←/→ switch  [/] size  C character  A loop  M sound  1/2/3/4 select

zh: 输入主机的局域网 IP、公网 IP 或域名；端口固定为 27018
en: Enter the host LAN IP, public IP, or hostname; port is fixed to 27018

zh: C控制/解除角色 · WASD移动 · 左键普攻 · 右键技能 · 中键扩展动作
en: C control/release · WASD move · Left attack · Right skill · Middle extra action

zh: 先在地图上放队伍位置
第%d轮尚未同时放置蓝队与红队人物，请补齐后开战。
en: Round %d needs both Blue and Red teams. Complete the formation before starting.

zh: 每名蓝队独立挑战整支红队；失败或通关后重置双方状态并换下一名蓝队。
en: Each blue fighter challenges the entire red roster. Reset for the next blue fighter after defeat or victory.

zh: 蝙蝠群吸附敌人吸血，按实际伤害永久增加生命上限并回血，啃护盾更快；吸附无护盾目标时减伤并免疫击退。定时合成吸血鬼，再分裂为蝙蝠群，合分保留总生命；吸血鬼吸血回复翻倍，当前生命越高伤害越高。
en: Bats latch on and drain enemies, permanently gaining maximum health and healing by actual damage; shields are bitten faster. Feeding on an unshielded target reduces incoming damage and prevents knockback. The swarm periodically merges into a vampire and splits again, preserving total health. The vampire heals twice the drained amount and deals more damage at higher current health.

zh: 按音乐节拍向左右发射音波，各声道响度决定伤害、速度、范围与展开角度，每道音波对同一敌人只命中一次。连续命中提高伤害并扩大后续音波角度，左右同轮只叠一次；整轮落空后层数逐渐衰减，再次命中停止衰减。低频音波附带轻微击退。
en: Fires sound waves left and right to the music. Channel loudness controls damage, speed, range and spread; each wave hits an enemy once. Consecutive hits increase damage and widen later waves, gaining only one stack per paired volley. A fully missed volley starts gradual stack decay; another hit stops it. Low-frequency waves also cause slight knockback.

zh: 觉醒时免伤并反弹弹丸，完成后爆炸。普通形态诞生爆炸基础伤害80，头弹直击30、爆炸波及20，冲刺80。三颗头独立发射，直击与波及不重复结算，并施加凋零；冲刺穿敌、击退并破坏障碍。仅Boss模式的Boss方开启特殊化时，基础生命为1000，诞生爆炸120、头弹直击50、波及25、冲刺100，并在首次半血召唤350生命的信标。伤害仍受当前属性影响。信标向上持续发射伤害光柱，发射时随机给予速度、急迫、抗性或力量，信标死亡清除其增益。
en: Immune and reflects projectiles while awakening, then explodes. Normal base damage: awakening 80, skull direct hit 30, splash 20 and charge 80. Three heads fire independently; direct and splash damage do not stack on the same victim, and skulls inflict Wither. Charges through enemies, knocking them back and breaking obstacles. Only on the Boss side in Boss mode with specialization enabled: base health 1000, awakening damage 120, skull direct hit 50, splash 25 and charge 100; summons a 350-health beacon once at half health. Damage still scales with current attributes. The beacon fires an upward damaging beam and grants a random Speed, Haste, Resistance or Strength buff when firing begins; the buff ends if the beacon dies.

zh: 石剑两连砍，每刀对每名敌人只命中一次，攻击期间减速。敌人在近战范围外时积累烟雾弹冷却，进入近战范围则暂停；就绪后发射无视墙体的轻度追踪弹。砍击或烟雾弹实际造成伤害后施加凋零，已有凋零则提升一级并刷新本来源时长；眩晕、死亡或禁攻取消余刀。
en: Performs two sword slashes, each hitting an enemy once, while moving more slowly. Its smoke-bolt cooldown advances only while the enemy is outside melee range; when ready, it fires a mildly homing bolt that passes through walls. Damaging slashes and bolts apply Wither, or increase its active level and refresh this source duration. Stun, death or disabled attacks cancel unfinished slashes.

zh: 抛钩命中伤害并减速，落地钩可挂住经过的敌人；收回沿途伤敌并猛拉，接近后追加剑斩。近身也会直接挥剑，斩击后退开；甩竿与剑击共用冷却，地形会阻挡钓钩和拉回路径。
en: A cast hook damages and slows; a resting hook can catch passing enemies. Reeling damages enemies along the return path and pulls them in for a sword slash. Also slashes nearby enemies directly and retreats afterward. Casting and slashing share a cooldown; terrain blocks hooks and their return paths.

zh: 近身碰撞伤敌；受伤或死亡会震动附近石砖并孵化同阵营蠹虫，整群最多十只。新生蠹虫继续参战并继承整群存续身份，必须消灭整群才算淘汰。
en: Damages enemies on contact. Taking damage or dying agitates nearby stone bricks, hatching allied silverfish up to a family limit of ten. Offspring continue fighting for the same contestant; the entire family must be eliminated.

zh: 发射火球，火球可被攻击打回并改变归属；命中爆炸造成范围伤害与击退，不分敌我，也能伤及恶魂并破坏可破坏地形。
en: Fires fireballs that can be struck back, changing their ownership. Impact explosions deal area damage and knockback without distinguishing friend from foe, can hurt the ghast itself, and destroy breakable terrain.

zh: 蓄力时减速，蓄力越久箭速和击退越强，伤害随实际箭速变化；敌人贴近会提前松弦。箭受重力影响，命中人物只结算一次。
en: Slows while drawing; longer draws produce faster arrows and stronger knockback, with damage based on actual arrow speed. Releases early against nearby enemies. Arrows fall under gravity and hit a character only once.

zh: 附近每名敌人持续供能，蓄能时逐渐减速，无人时恢复移速，已有能量与贡献保留。满条复制本轮贡献最多者，平局取先贡献者；复制品体型及除移速外公共属性减半，技能参数保持。旧复制品继续参战，复制品及其后代不会伤害或锁定皓宸一方，并与皓宸共用存续身份。
en: Each nearby enemy supplies energy while Haochen gradually slows; movement recovers when none remain, without losing stored energy or contributions. A full meter copies the greatest contributor this cycle, breaking ties by earliest contribution. Copies have half size and half common stats except movement speed; skill parameters are unchanged. Existing copies remain. Copies and their descendants cannot target or harm Haochen allies and share his battle survival identity.

zh: 远处召唤直线尖牙，近处释放多圈尖牙并向外击退，同圈不重复伤害。定期补充可穿内部墙体的恼鬼，恼鬼不会自然消失；首次致死伤害由不死图腾保命并恢复生命，同时从触发处扩散金绿波纹，对扫到的敌人造成低伤害并中等击退。
en: Summons a line of fangs at range, or several outward-pushing rings nearby; each ring hits a victim once. Periodically replenishes vexes that pass through internal walls and do not expire naturally. A Totem of Undying prevents the first lethal hit and restores health, releasing an expanding gold-green wave that deals low damage and moderate outward knockback.

zh: 尖啸体监听敌人的移动、碰撞与攻击，警戒充满后向声源发射伤害探测波，回响积满唤醒监守者并按比例提升生命。苏醒后追随最响声源，近处挥击，远处蓄力发射穿墙穿盾并击退的声波，已开始的蓄力不被眩晕打断。巨响使其短暂加速，持续安静则潜地并重置警戒。
en: The shrieker detects enemy movement, collisions and attacks. Full alert launches damaging probes at sound locations; enough returning echoes awaken the Warden and raise health proportionally. It follows the loudest sound, strikes nearby enemies and charges terrain- and shield-piercing sonic knockback attacks at range; stun does not cancel a committed charge. Loud noise briefly boosts speed; prolonged silence causes burrowing and resets alert.

zh: 持续战斗逐渐提高射速，开弓时锁定本箭方向。箭矢命中后嵌入身体，每支箭提高斩杀线，敌人生命降到阈值时拔箭处决；插在障碍上的箭也能伤害碰到它的敌人，随后消失。
en: Fire rate increases over the battle. Each shot locks its direction when drawing begins. Embedded arrows raise the execution threshold; sufficiently low-health victims trigger an arrow-pull execution. Arrows lodged in obstacles also damage enemies that touch them, then disappear.

zh: 敌人靠近时积累引信并减速，离开后引信逐渐回退，蓄满自爆并击退敌人。定期引雷，伤害并眩晕附近敌人，自身充能后引信更短、爆炸更强更广。自爆后头部飞出，按速度撞伤敌人，减速后继续移动并再次蓄满引信自爆。
en: Nearby enemies build its fuse and slow its movement; the fuse recedes after they leave. A full fuse causes a knockback explosion. Periodic lightning damages and stuns nearby enemies and charges the creeper, shortening its fuse and strengthening and enlarging its blast. After exploding, its head flies off and deals speed-based collision damage, then slows and continues fighting until a second fuse-triggered explosion.

zh: 蓄势铺轨后沿轨加速，动力轨加速更强，车速无上限，撞击伤害随速度提高。轨道可转弯、交汇或闭环，新轨覆盖方向但保留动力属性；离轨保留惯性与撞击伤害并逐渐减速，再入轨继承余速。闭环行驶一段后向外脱轨，轨道本局持续保留。
en: Lays rails after preparing, then accelerates without a speed cap; powered rails accelerate faster and collision damage rises with speed. Tracks support bends, junctions and loops; replacements change direction but retain powered status. Off-rail movement keeps momentum and collision damage while slowing, and reentry inherits remaining speed. Loops eventually eject the cart. Rails persist for the battle.

zh: 只有身体碰撞伤害，移动越快伤害越高，没有上限。被动时间加速：开战后时间持续加快且没有上限，投射物、药水效果、场上危险物、世界时间与时钟自身都会加速，其它角色不受影响。被动倒流：定期回到一秒前的位置、生命与效果，倒流时无敌。高速时留下残像，残像（含倒流残像）都有碰撞和伤害。被动停时：每局一次，受到致命伤害时锁住最后一点生命，展开盖住全图的表盘圈，圈内黑白且除时钟外一切静止，时钟无敌并穿过人物，圈消失后一次性结算期间的伤害。
en: Body-collision damage only, rising with speed, uncapped. Passive Time Acceleration: projectiles, potion effects, hazards, world time and the Clock itself keep speeding up without limit; other characters do not. Passive Rewind: periodically returns to its position, health and effects from one second earlier, invulnerable while rewinding. At high speed it leaves afterimages; all of them, rewind trails included, are solid and deal damage. Passive Time Stop: once per match, a lethal blow leaves it at its last point of health and opens a clock-face circle covering the map. Inside, the world turns black and white and freezes except for the Clock, which is invulnerable and passes through characters. Damage dealt meanwhile is settled when the circle vanishes.

zh: 连射烈焰弹，命中造成火焰伤害并持续灼烧。弹丸击中地面或障碍会留下火场，持续伤害并点燃踩入的敌人。环绕烈焰棒能挡住接触棒体的可格挡投射物；攻击时展开旋转，接触敌人造成伤害。
en: Fires bursts of fireballs that deal fire damage and inflict burning. Terrain or obstacle impacts leave ground fire that repeatedly damages and ignites enemies. Orbiting rods intercept blockable projectiles that touch them; while attacking, they spread out, spin and damage enemies on contact.

zh: 带两只缰绳羊驼，羊驼吐口水攻击并在受击后反击，被缰绳拉动时按速度撞伤并击退敌人。自身有负面状态才喝奶净化，受威胁可喝隐身药水或入墙避敌，再从安全墙位出场。羊驼阵亡后需等待补回冷却，下次出墙补回一只；商人死亡时羊驼退场。
en: Brings two leashed llamas that spit at enemies and retaliate after being hit. Leash-pulled llamas deal speed-based collision damage and knockback. Drinks milk only to cleanse negative effects; under threat, uses invisibility or enters a wall and exits at a safer location. A lost llama becomes replaceable after a cooldown, with one returning on the next wall exit. Llamas leave when the trader dies.

zh: 轮换并同时保留最近两种方块特性。冰：铺冰加速，自身持有冰时无加速上限，撞击随速度增伤；岩浆：火伤与灼烧，顶部持续烫伤并免疫火焰；蜂蜜：短暂黏住并拖拽敌人，无独立伤害。铁：减伤、减速，跳砸并持续压伤底部敌人；紫晶：长刺接触伤敌，可射出并再生，每根独立命中；TNT：引信爆炸伤敌并自伤、反冲，消耗该槽后补新块。失去铁时调整移动方向。
en: Cycles blocks and retains the latest two traits. Ice lays accelerating trails, removes its own trail speed cap and adds speed-based collision damage. Magma deals fire damage and burning, scorches enemies above and grants fire immunity. Honey briefly grabs and drags without separate damage. Iron reduces damage and speed, leaps and crushes enemies underneath. Amethyst grows independently damaging spikes that can be launched and regrown. TNT explodes, damaging enemies and itself and causing recoil, then consumes its slot and adds a new block. Losing iron redirects movement.

zh: 概率瞬移闪避，投射物另有必闪判定，闪避有概率留下分身。对视与闪避积累怒气，暴怒后加速并反复瞬移到敌人背后冲撞；被持续注视可延长暴怒，但有时长上限。
en: Can teleport to dodge attacks, with a guaranteed fallback against projectiles; dodges may leave clones. Mutual eye contact and dodging build anger. Rage increases speed and repeatedly teleports it behind enemies to rush them. Continued observation extends rage up to a duration limit.

zh: 加速航行，高速撞击和转弯划桨伤敌，速度影响伤害。可搭载两名角色，船与乘员分摊外来伤害，乘员仍可攻击；抓到敌人后会撞墙伤害敌方乘员。触墙减速，船毁后释放乘员。
en: Accelerates to ram enemies and deals paddle damage while turning, with speed affecting damage. Carries up to two characters; the boat and passengers share external damage, while passengers can still attack. With an enemy aboard, it rams walls to hurt hostile passengers. Wall contact reduces speed; destruction releases passengers.

zh: 蓄力越久，挥剑越快，伤害和击退越强，普通击退不打断蓄力。挥剑与受伤消耗耐久，耗尽后剑柄与剑刃分开作战，分别擅长击退和伤害。碎片接触工作台回血并减伤，全部到齐停留可重制，合并生命并恢复耐久；离开重置进度，缺失碎片或工作台被毁则不能重制。
en: Longer charges swing faster and deal stronger damage and knockback; ordinary knockback does not interrupt charging. Swinging and taking damage consume durability. At zero durability, hilt and blade fight separately, specializing in knockback and damage. Workbench contact heals and protects fragments; keeping all fragments there rebuilds the sword, combines health and restores durability. Leaving resets progress; a missing fragment or destroyed workbench prevents rebuilding.

zh: 移动持续加速，矛尖伤害随自身速度及敌人迎面速度提高；命中加速，顺向命中收益更高。高速穿刺短暂提速，顺向直穿伤害更高但消耗更多蓄速；矛头可格挡并消除可格挡投射物，撞墙减速，眩晕重置速度。
en: Movement builds speed. Tip damage scales with its own speed and an enemy approaching head-on; hits accelerate it, with larger gains from aligned hits. High-speed piercing briefly boosts speed; straight-through attacks hit harder but consume more stored speed. Its tip blocks and removes blockable projectiles. Walls slow it down; stun resets speed.

zh: 投掷三叉戟，贯穿人物后回收，撞墙会插住并在等待后补出新戟。手持或插墙的戟随时间附魔，引雷伤害并眩晕，雷电可使其他合适的三叉戟带电；带电接触追加落雷。同队有效三叉戟定期相连成电网，伤害并短暂眩晕接触敌人。
en: Throws tridents through characters and retrieves them; wall impacts lodge the trident and eventually trigger a replacement. Held or lodged tridents become enchanted over time, summoning damaging, stunning lightning that can charge other eligible tridents. Charged contact calls another strike. Allied eligible tridents periodically connect into an electric network that damages and briefly stuns enemies.

zh: 随机炼制增益、治疗、伤害或负面药水，通常喝增益并向敌人投负面，但可能误用。高血量时不炼治疗系药水；面对治疗与伤害反转的敌人会调整药水用途，敌人全为反转类型时解除治疗药限制。投掷药水在落点按各自效果结算。
en: Brews random buffs, healing, damage or debuff potions. Usually drinks beneficial potions and throws harmful ones, but can make mistakes. At high health it does not brew healing potions. Against enemies with inverted healing and damage, it adjusts potion use; if all enemies are inverted, the healing restriction is removed. Thrown potions apply their respective effects around impact.

zh: 沿地面与侧墙移动，闭壳时移动较慢并格挡伤害，开壳发射追踪浮空弹。连射数量随战斗时间增长；开壳受伤有概率瞬移到安全位置。
en: Moves along floors and side walls. Closing its shell slows movement and blocks damage; opening it fires homing levitation bullets. Volley size grows with battle time. Taking damage while open can trigger a teleport to safety.

zh: 滑翔并用烟花加速，矛尖伤害随飞行速度提高；低速点刺后退开，高速贯穿且命中加速更多。对准敌人可发动穿刺冲刺，穿过后回转；越出地图时自动回航。
en: Glides with firework boosts; spear-tip damage rises with flight speed. Low-speed pokes retreat afterward, while high-speed hits pierce and grant larger speed boosts. Alignment enables a piercing dash followed by a turn back. Automatically steers back when outside the arena.

zh: 滑翔并用烟花推进，近敌俯冲锤击；命中后跃起连砸，提高高度、范围、伤害与击退，砸空结束。腾空时强控暂停连砸，解控后接续进度与层数；普通击退、减速不暂停。越界回航不取消已开始的连砸。
en: Glides with firework boosts and dives to strike enemies. Hits start rebound slams with increasing height, area, damage and knockback; missing ends the chain. Hard control pauses an airborne slam without losing progress or chain level; ordinary knockback and slows do not pause it. Arena-return steering does not cancel a committed chain.

zh: 烟花助飞，矛尖按速度伤敌，低速点刺后退开，高速贯穿并强化命中加速；命中触发范围锤击与连砸，冲刺先穿过再起跳。连砸逐级扩大范围、伤害，砸空结束；腾空时强控暂停，解控后保留进度与层数续砸，普通击退、减速不暂停；越界回航不取消连砸。
en: Flies with firework boosts and deals speed-based spear damage. Low-speed pokes retreat; high-speed piercing gains more speed on hit. Hits trigger an area mace strike and rebound slams; a dash finishes piercing before the leap. Chained slams grow in area and damage until a miss. Hard control pauses airborne progress without losing chain level; ordinary knockback, slows and arena-return steering do not interrupt the chain.

zh: 实际移动积累本局永久移速，四个分身定时随机切换随行、旋转与伸缩三种阵形。速度越高，随行越收拢、旋转越快、伸刺越远；仅运动矛头按速度造成伤害，伸缩阵待机和回收无伤害。旋转阵仅四个分身矛头可格挡并消除可格挡投射物，矛杆和间隙不能格挡。
en: Actual movement permanently builds speed for the battle. Four copies periodically switch between following, orbiting and thrusting formations. Higher speed tightens the following formation, accelerates orbit and extends thrusts. Only moving tips deal speed-based damage; idle and retracting thrusts are harmless. In orbit formation, only the four copy tips block and remove blockable projectiles, not shafts or gaps.

zh: 跳跃时碰撞伤敌，落地造成范围伤害并减速。死亡时爆发伤害与击退，并分裂成两只更小的史莱姆，最小形态不再分裂；所有后代共用原角色存续身份。
en: Damages enemies during jumps; landings deal area damage and slow. Death causes a damaging knockback pulse and splits it into two smaller slimes, except at the smallest stage. All descendants continue fighting for the original contestant.

zh: 锁定敌人蓄力激光，命中对目标造成高伤害，并伤害、侧推光路上的其他敌人。近身蓄力伸刺爆发，伸刺期间持续接触伤害。实际受伤会延后激光和尖刺攻击，伤害越高延迟越长。
en: Locks on and charges a high-damage laser; other enemies crossing its beam also take damage and are pushed sideways. Nearby enemies trigger a charged spike burst, with repeated contact damage while extended. Actual damage received delays laser and spike attacks, with larger hits causing longer delays.

zh: 定期铺设可叠层苔藓，接触格独立伤害与冷却，层数越高伤害越高，减速取接触格最强档；自身接触回血，踩踏不消耗。与敌人位于相连苔藓时可钻地突袭其入地时位置，伤害并击退，消耗附近苔藓回血。苔藓永久保留且不阻挡移动，可被恶魂爆炸破坏；出口被毁或受阻会取消突袭。
en: Periodically spreads stackable moss. Each touched cell has independent damage and cooldown; deeper layers deal more damage, while only the strongest contacted slow applies. Contact heals the owner without consuming moss. Connected moss enables a burrowing ambush at the enemy position recorded on entry, dealing damage and knockback and consuming nearby moss to heal. Moss persists without blocking movement but can be destroyed by ghast explosions; blocked or destroyed exits cancel ambushes.

zh: 蓄力发射追踪穿墙箭，命中引落范围箭雨并留下裂隙，箭体不击退。受击时可消耗可用裂隙躲避并瞬移，过程中免伤，到达后持续向外冲击、伤害并击退敌人；没有安全裂隙或冷却未结束时不能闪避。
en: Charges homing arrows that pass through terrain, trigger area arrow rain on impact and leave rifts; the arrow itself causes no knockback. On an incoming hit, an available rift can be consumed to dodge and teleport with transit immunity. Arrival causes repeated outward damage and knockback. Dodging requires a safe rift and a ready cooldown.

zh: 周期性吹响山羊角，吹奏时移速减半，起手被眩晕会中断。每次从屏幕外召来一群山羊，各自锁定一名随机敌人当时的位置直线冲去（不追踪）：冲撞造成击退，速度越快伤害与击退越高，被撞上墙额外受伤；持续顶住会不断推撞并造成伤害。山羊无敌、不可选中、穿墙，撞完或错过后加速冲出屏幕；本体死亡后山羊不再造成伤害。
en: Periodically blows the goat horn, moving at half speed while blowing; a stun during the windup interrupts it. Each call summons a herd of goats from off-screen, each charging in a straight line at where a random enemy stood when it appeared (no homing). Rams knock targets back, with damage and knockback rising with goat speed and extra damage when the target hits a wall; goats that keep pushing deal repeated damage and knockback. Goats are invulnerable, untargetable and pass through walls, then accelerate off-screen after ramming or missing; they stop dealing damage once the horn dies.

zh: 一名选手由花岗岩、闪长岩、安山岩三块方块组成，各自移动并远程投掷石块，三块全部碎掉才算落败。花岗岩伤害最高、攻速中等，命中小幅击退并施加缓慢，缓慢不叠加，再次命中重置时间。闪长岩每次命中都提高自身攻速，叠加没有上限；石块落空后加成开始逐渐衰减，再次命中即停止衰减。安山岩攻速最慢、伤害低，命中时治疗三块中生命最少的一块，目标越残血治疗越多；并每隔一段时间给三块石头施加数秒急迫 III。治疗和急迫都以地面石头波纹从安山岩射向队友，抵达时生效。
en: One competitor made of three blocks (granite, diorite and andesite) that move independently and throw stones from range; it is defeated only when all three break. Granite deals the highest damage at a medium attack speed; its hits knock back slightly and apply Slowness, which does not stack and is refreshed by each hit. Every diorite hit raises its own attack speed, stacking without limit; after a stone misses, the bonus starts to fade, and the next hit stops the fade. Andesite attacks slowest for low damage; its hits heal whichever stone has the least health, healing more the lower that stone is, and it periodically grants all three stones a few seconds of Haste III. Heals and Haste travel from the andesite to its allies as a rippling wave of stone along the ground and take effect on arrival.

zh: 随机选上下左右一侧，3 秒后在那里聚起乌云，之后每 2 秒朝避雷针劈 2–5 道闪电，每 9 秒换到另一侧。闪电落到针上时对周围小范围造成伤害并眩晕；每道闪电的路径留下一段电网，碰到的敌人受到高频伤害和短眩晕。落雷为身下能量条充能：被攻击时朝周围放电，消耗能量；能量满时释放大范围扩散雷圈，造成高频伤害和眩晕。能量接近满时针身颤抖，越满抖得越厉害。
en: Picks a random side (up, down, left or right); 3 seconds later a storm cloud gathers there and strikes the rod with 2 to 5 lightning bolts every 2 seconds, moving to another side every 9 seconds. Each bolt landing on the rod damages and stuns enemies in a small area around it, and leaves an electric net along its path that deals rapid damage and short stuns to enemies touching it. Bolts charge the bar under the rod: when hit, the rod discharges into its surroundings, spending charge; at full charge it releases a wide expanding thunder ring that deals rapid damage and stuns. Near full charge the rod trembles, harder the closer it gets.

zh: 书本按固定周期开合：合上时减免部分伤害；翻开时失去减免，持续从书页边上冒出附魔符文，慢速飞向最近的敌人或友军并略微追踪，穿过墙体。符文命中敌人造成低伤害，命中友军回复等量生命。每个目标左上角用罗马数字 I 到 X 显示被命中次数，到 X 时清零并获得一个随机附魔：友军为正面等级，敌人为负面等级，负面等级效果相反并以红字显示。附魔只从对该目标真实生效的附魔中抽取，可叠加，正负等级相互抵消，整场战斗保留。
en: Its book opens and closes on a fixed cycle. While closed it takes reduced damage; while open it loses that reduction and keeps sending enchanting runes out from the edges of its pages that drift slowly toward the nearest enemy or ally, homing slightly and passing through walls. Runes deal low damage to enemies and heal allies by the same amount. Each target shows its hit count as Roman numerals I to X at its top left; at X the count resets and the target gains a random enchantment: positive levels for allies, negative levels for enemies, which have the opposite effect and are shown in red. Enchantments are drawn only from those that actually affect that target, stack, cancel opposite levels and last for the whole battle.

zh: 火焰尖端持续燃烧，不断向四周掉落火星，火星落地变成火焰：敌人踩在火上持续受伤并陷入燃烧。地图外围有一圈灵魂沙，会随机向地图内蔓延，最终可铺满全图；新蔓延的灵魂沙会从相邻的一侧逐渐长满；任何角色站在长满的灵魂沙上都会减速，灵魂疾行附魔可以抵消减速，等级越高在灵魂沙上走得越快。火把站在灵魂沙上会积累脚下的进度条，积满后永久变成灵魂火把：掉火星更快，落在灵魂沙上的火星变成灵魂火，伤害与燃烧都翻倍。灵魂火把碰到自己的灵魂火时化作火焰，依次冲刺到最近的、没有被墙挡住的其他灵魂火，每团只经过一次且不消耗；途中扫到的敌人受到伤害与燃烧并被击退，全部经过后恢复火把并进入冷却。火把死亡后火焰熄灭、灵魂沙消散。
en: Its flame tip burns constantly and keeps dropping sparks around it; sparks land as fire, and enemies standing in the fire take repeated damage and start burning. A ring of soul sand surrounds the map and creeps inward at random until it can cover the whole arena; new soul sand gradually grows in from the side it spread from, and anyone standing on fully grown soul sand is slowed; the Soul Speed enchantment cancels the slowdown, and higher levels move faster on soul sand. Standing on soul sand fills the bar under the torch, and once full it permanently becomes a Soul Torch: sparks fall faster, and sparks landing on soul sand become soul fire with doubled damage and burning. When the Soul Torch touches one of its own soul fires it turns into a flame and dashes to the nearest other soul fire not blocked by walls, visiting each once without consuming it; enemies it sweeps through take damage, start burning and are knocked back. After the last one it turns back into a torch and goes on cooldown. When the torch dies its fires go out and the soul sand fades.

zh: 每隔一段时间在脚下倒出一格水源，水会照我的世界的规则向四周流开，越远越浅，两格水源之间的水也会变成水源，相连的水连成一片。水流会把水里的角色顺着水流方向往外推，水桶自己不受影响。泡在水里的角色头顶出现氧气条，氧气耗尽后会溺水，按生命上限的比例持续掉血；离开水后氧气慢慢恢复，满了就隐藏。水不会自己消失。水碰到岩浆时变成石头，碰到岩浆源头时变成黑曜石；方块过一段时间会碎掉，黑曜石更持久；方块出现时站在那里的角色会被卡在里面并持续窒息受伤。
en: Every so often it pours a water source at its feet. The water flows outward by Minecraft rules, getting shallower the farther it goes; water between two sources becomes a source too, and connected water merges. The current pushes anyone in the water outward along the flow, except the water bucket itself. Units in the water get an oxygen bar above their heads; when the air runs out they drown and lose a share of their max health over time. Out of the water the air slowly refills and the bar hides when full. The water never disappears on its own. Where water meets lava it turns into stone, and where it meets a lava source it turns into obsidian; the blocks break after a while, obsidian lasting longer, and anyone standing where a block forms gets stuck inside it and keeps taking suffocation damage.

zh: 每隔一段时间在脚下倒出一格岩浆源，岩浆照我的世界的规则向四周流开，比水流得更慢更近，相连的岩浆连成一片。站在岩浆里的敌人会减速，持续受到火焰伤害并陷入燃烧。岩浆源过一段时间会消失，岩浆从中心向外慢慢退去；岩浆桶死亡后它的岩浆也会退去。岩浆碰到水时变成石头，岩浆源头碰到水时变成黑曜石；方块过一段时间会碎掉，黑曜石更持久；方块出现时站在那里的角色会被卡在里面并持续窒息受伤。
en: Every so often it pours a lava source at its feet. The lava flows outward by Minecraft rules, slower and shorter than water, and connected lava merges. Enemies standing in lava are slowed, take repeated fire damage and start burning. Each lava source vanishes after a while and the lava recedes from the centre outward; when the lava bucket dies its lava recedes too. Where lava meets water it turns into stone, and a lava source touched by water turns into obsidian; the blocks break after a while, obsidian lasting longer, and anyone standing where a block forms gets stuck inside it and keeps taking suffocation damage.

zh: 近身挥剑，空闲时持续锻造，越久不攻击锻造越快，眩晕期间仍积累加速。每完成数次锻造随机升级剑或头盔，提高伤害或防护；装备满级后继续锻造可永久提高伤害或护甲。
en: Slashes nearby enemies and forges while idle. Longer periods without attacking accelerate forging, including time spent stunned. Every few forging cycles randomly upgrades the sword or helmet, increasing damage or protection. After equipment is fully upgraded, further forging permanently improves damage or armor.

zh: 蓄力上挑，蓄得越久伤害与击飞越强，并使敌人短暂眩晕。随行村民可修复生命；村民死亡后永久狂暴，提高攻击、移速和攻速。
en: Charges an uppercut; longer charges increase damage and launch strength and briefly stun enemies. Its accompanying villager repairs health. If the villager dies, permanent rage increases damage, movement speed and attack speed.

zh: 受重力影响，跃向敌人并持续横向追踪，下落越快伤害越高。跳跃可穿过人物但仍会受伤，碰地形立即下砸；砸中敌人后继续下落，底部接触持续压伤并击退，侧面与顶部不造成压伤。命中后落地可继续连砸，次数不限；落空后进入冷却。
en: Obeys gravity, leaps toward enemies and keeps tracking horizontally; faster falls deal more damage. The jump passes through characters but remains vulnerable, and terrain contact triggers an immediate slam. Enemy hits do not stop the fall; continued underside contact crushes and pushes victims, unlike side or top contact. A hit allows another slam after landing, with no chain-count limit; a miss starts the cooldown.

zh: 连续命中加快挥剑，攻击期间略微减速；挥空、打断或长时间未续上命中重置加速。持续生锈，锈满后自然落雷实际命中时清锈、清除负面状态并附电，保留正面增益。雷电伤害并眩晕敌人，附电挥剑命中也会引雷，但攻击引雷不净化。
en: Consecutive hits accelerate sword swings, which slightly slow movement. A miss, interruption or long gap between hits resets the speed bonus. Rust builds over time; when fully rusted, a natural lightning strike clears rust and negative effects and charges the sword, preserving buffs. Lightning damages and stuns enemies. Charged melee hits also call lightning, but these attack strikes do not cleanse.

zh: 迷雾遮蔽全场，近身和面朝方向可见，墙体挡视野；潜行时不能被自动锁定，但仍会被范围攻击命中。持续暴露会损失生命并消散，随后尽量在视野外重现。成功绕后预警落雷并狂暴，交替退开、化雾穿身或现身范围突袭；化雾仍可受伤但不扣暴露生命，狂暴后进入冷却。
en: Fog limits vision to nearby space and facing direction, with walls blocking sight. Stealth prevents automatic targeting but not area hits. Prolonged exposure costs health and disperses it before it reappears, preferably out of sight. Successful flanking warns of lightning and triggers rage, alternating retreat with mist pass-through attacks or area ambushes. Mist form remains vulnerable but avoids exposure health loss; rage is followed by a cooldown.

zh: 定期长高，层数有上限，身体随之增大；只有左右两侧接触伤害。主动向两侧散射尖刺，越高刺越多。实际受伤后向两侧反击，反击总量随承伤和层数提高；每根刺只命中一次，扎入目标或墙后不会持续伤害。
en: Periodically grows taller up to a layer limit, enlarging its body; only its sides deal contact damage. Fires thorns to both sides, with more thorns at greater height. Actual damage received triggers retaliation whose total scales with damage taken and height. Each thorn hits once and causes no continuing damage after lodging in a target or wall.

zh: 雪球伤害、轻微击退并积累寒冷；完整雪径持续伤害与积寒，融化后无害并消失。寒冷降低移速与攻速，积满短暂冻结，冰壳可打碎。普通攻击有概率连射二十颗散射雪球；首次半血触发一次必连射，若正在连射则保留到下一轮。
en: Snowballs damage, slightly knock back and build cold. Full snow trails repeatedly damage and chill, then become harmless while melting away. Cold slows movement and attacks; a full meter briefly freezes the victim in breakable ice. Normal attacks can trigger a twenty-shot spread volley. Reaching half health guarantees one volley; if already firing one, the guarantee carries to the next attack.

zh: 可消耗羊毛弹开近敌与来袭投射物，脱毛后移速提高。蓄力冲撞伤害与击退随速度提高，蓄力和冲撞时抵抗击退，高速撞墙会自伤并眩晕。低血量且一段时间未受伤后停下吃草回血，累计治疗可长回羊毛；受伤中断进食，满血结束。
en: Spends wool to repel nearby enemies and incoming projectiles; being shorn increases speed. Charge damage and knockback scale with impact speed. Resists knockback while preparing and charging; fast wall crashes cause self-damage and stun. At low health, a period without damage allows stationary grazing that heals and regrows wool. Taking damage interrupts grazing; full health ends it.

zh: 持续生成音符，随时间提高生成速度与容量；音符追踪伤敌，并可收集来袭投射物后返还攻击敌人。近敌时召回飞行音符，旋转收拢后爆发范围伤害与击退；收集物有容量上限，返还保留其原有攻击特性。
en: Continuously generates notes, gaining faster generation and higher capacity over time. Notes home toward enemies and can collect incoming projectiles to send back. Nearby enemies trigger recall of flying notes, which spiral inward before an area damage and knockback burst. Captured cargo has limited capacity; returned projectiles retain their original attack properties.

zh: 向前反复伸缩，活塞头可黏住敌人，前端刺击持续伤敌；未被黏住的目标会被推开，撞墙可眩晕。连续攻击逐渐加快伸缩并减慢自身移动，停攻后衰减。
en: Repeatedly extends forward. Its head can hold enemies while the front spike damages them; unheld targets are pushed away and can be stunned against walls. Sustained attacking speeds up the strokes while slowing its own movement; the buildup fades after stopping.

zh: 接触墙面拉出蛛丝，连线与交叉处形成捕猎网络；接触蛛丝或蛛网会受伤并减速，蛛网减速更强。敌人触网后向其扑击，造成额外伤害，墙体会阻挡扑击命中。
en: Anchors silk to walls, forming a hunting network of strands and webs at intersections. Silk and web contact damage and slow enemies, with stronger slowing in webs. Enemies caught in webs trigger a damaging lunge; walls block its hit.

zh: 近身挥锤命中后跃起连砸，落地造成范围伤害与击退；命中可续跳并提高高度、范围、伤害和击退。高度、范围有上限，续跳伤害仍可增长。腾空时眩晕、冰冻等强控暂停连砸，解控后接续进度与层数；普通击退、减速不暂停。砸空结束。
en: A close-range hit starts rebound slams with area damage and knockback. Successful landings increase height, area, damage and knockback; height and area are capped, but chain damage can keep growing. Stuns and freezes pause an airborne slam, preserving progress and chain level until release. Ordinary knockback and slows do not pause it. Missing ends the chain.

zh: 近身挥斩并向前释放推进的横扫剑气。取得下界合金锭并接触锻造台后停下锻造，升级为下界合金剑，增加当前与最大生命、攻击力和攻速；离开锻造台会中断等待。
en: Slashes nearby enemies and sends a sweeping attack forward. After obtaining a netherite ingot, touching a smithing table starts a stationary upgrade to a netherite sword, increasing current and maximum health, damage and attack speed. Leaving the table interrupts the wait.

zh: 移动加速，转向损失速度，命中再提速；速度提高刺击伤害与虚影数量，高速虚影升级为贯穿攻击。正面刺击附带定点虚影连刺，侧面半周横扫并击退；目标位于正面且路径可通行时，蓄势瞬移贯穿并留下虚影。
en: Movement builds speed, turning loses it, and hits restore more. Speed increases thrust damage and echo count; fast echoes upgrade to piercing attacks. Frontal thrusts trigger fixed-position echo volleys, while side attacks sweep a half-circle with knockback. A frontal target and clear path allow a prepared blink-pierce with echoes.

zh: 高抬斧蓄力后挥砍，蓄力越久伤害越高；达到50%时穿透格挡、招架和弹反，达到75%时无视护甲及伤害减免，但仍可被闪避或无敌防住。可加速冲向敌人，冲刺途中蓄力，接近后按实际蓄力挥斧。强控会中断蓄力和冲刺。
en: Raises an axe to charge a stronger slash. At 50% charge it bypasses blocks, parries and guard reflections; at 75% it ignores armor and damage reduction, but not dodging or invulnerability. Can rush toward an enemy while charging, then swing using the charge actually accumulated. Hard control interrupts charging and rushing.

zh: 100生命，平时正常移动，发现附近敌人后追近；短暂起手后在敌人原位置咬击一次，目标离开咬合范围可躲开。咬伤按当前攻击与目标防御结算，墙体阻挡咬击；眩晕或禁攻取消未完成咬击。亡灵，治疗与伤害药水效果反转。
en: 100 health. Roams normally, then approaches nearby enemies. After a brief windup, bites once at the enemy's original position; moving out avoids the bite. Damage scales with current attack and target defense. Walls block bites; stun or disabled attacks cancel pending bites. Undead: healing and harming potions are inverted.

zh: 正常移动，自身无碰撞或直接攻击伤害。周期召唤两只100生命的僵尸，最多保有六只；召唤物独立咬击，本体死亡后仍继续战斗。投掷带拖尾的抛物线粘液球，命中敌人施加4秒缓慢II，不造成直接伤害；墙体可挡住粘液球。亡灵，治疗与伤害药水效果反转。
en: Moves normally and deals no contact or direct attack damage. Periodically summons two 100-health zombies, up to six living summons. They bite independently and keep fighting after the king dies. Throws trailing slime balls in an arc; enemy hits apply Slowness II for 4 seconds without direct damage. Walls stop slime balls. Undead: healing and harming potions are inverted.
